## PR description
### [Misc] Align CODEOWNERS with module/feature design docs
## Summary

Regenerate the `vllm_omni/**` source-tree rules in `CODEOWNERS` from the `owners` and `primary_code_paths` front matter in `docs/design/module/*.md`, making the design docs the authoritative source of truth for ownership. Each section header now cites its source design doc.

## What changed

**Conflicts resolved in favor of the design docs:**

| Path | Before | After |
|------|--------|-------|
| `/vllm_omni/engine/` | tzhouam, yinpeiqi, fake0fan, Sy0307 | tzhouam, fake0fan |
| `/vllm_omni/worker/` | tzhouam, gcanlin | tzhouam, yinpeiqi, fake0fan, Sy0307 |
| `/vllm_omni/entrypoints/` | tzhouam, yinpeiqi, fake0fan, alex-jw-brooks, NickCao | alex-jw-brooks, linyueqian, NickCao |
| `/vllm_omni/deploy/` | tzhouam, lishunyang12 | lishunyang12, alex-jw-brooks |
| `/vllm_omni/diffusion/offloader/` | 8 owners | yuanheng-zhao, Isotr0py, lishunyang12 |

**Coverage gaps filled** (previously fell to the `*` catch-all):
- `/vllm_omni/inputs/`, `/vllm_omni/outputs/`, `/vllm_omni/model_extras/`, `/vllm_omni/plugins/`, `/vllm_omni/errors.py`, `/vllm_omni/request.py`, `/vllm_omni/data_entry_keys.py`, `/vllm_omni/attention/`, `/vllm_omni/benchmarks/`

**File-level overrides** (last-match-wins) for cross-cutting ownership:
- io_contracts files inside `engine/` (`messages.py`, `serialization.py`, `mm_outputs.py`, `output_modality.py`, `output_processor.py`)
- `entrypoints/openai/errors.py` (error_contracts), `entrypoints/cli/benchmark/` (benchmarking), `model_executor/stage_configs/` (config)
- `model_executor/models/` carved out with tzhouam, gcanlin, Sy0307, amy-why-3459, linyueqian

**Full diffusion sub-module split** (umbrella rule first; sub-rules after it win via last-match): cache/, quantization/, profiler/, sched/+executor/+worker/, models/+model_loader/+lora/, distributed/+attention-parallel/, offloader/.

## Design docs updated (to stay in sync)

- `docs/design/module/entrypoints.md` — add @NickCao to `owners`
- `docs/design/module/diffusion/offloader.md` — add @lishunyang12 to `owners`
- `docs/design/module/model_integration.md` — add `primary_code_path_owners` block scoping @Sy0307, @amy-why-3459, @linyueqian to `vllm_omni/model_executor/models/**`

## Not changed

- `*` default owners
- Non-source sections: docs, recipes, CI, benchmarks, tests, apps
- `/vllm_omni/lora/` and `/vllm_omni/transformers_utils/` (no dedicated design doc defining ownership)

## Test plan

- [ ] `CODEOWNERS` syntax validated (last-match-wins ordering verified against 23 representative paths via simulation)
- [ ] Confirm no unintended ownership shifts for paths not listed above
